meta.name: connect
meta.description: Configure or diagnose access to a requested source using available host tools. Use for source MCP setup; source configuration needs no engagement record and credentials stay with the host.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把外部数据源接通到你的智能助手,连不上时帮你排查原因
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让助手读取某个数据源,却卡在配置或权限上。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to reach a data source but are stuck on setup or permissions.

howto.what: 装上后,它会用当前主机上现有的工具,帮你配置或排查对某个数据源的访问,适用于数据源的 MCP 设置。凭据留在主机侧,配置过程不需要登记记录。
howto.when: 当你要求配置或诊断某个数据源的访问、做数据源 MCP 设置时接管;若由 @fde 调用,会复用它当前的脱敏包与范围,不重新开始设置或追问已答过的问题。

say.text: 帮我配置对某个数据源的访问。
say.note: 用主机现有工具做配置或诊断。

say.text: 检查一下我能不能访问这个源。
say.note: 会如实报告缺失的能力或未跑的检查。

say.text: 复查一下这个数据源的连接是否正常。
say.note: 凭据留在主机侧,不做登记。

howto.what_en: It uses the host's available tools to configure or diagnose access to a source you name, including source MCP setup. Credentials stay with the host and no engagement record is required.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask to configure or diagnose access to a source, or need source MCP setup; if @fde calls it, it reuses its current sanitized packet and scope.

say_en.text: Set up access to this source for me.
say_en.note: Configures or diagnoses with host tools.

say_en.text: Check whether I can reach this source.
